visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair in a ponytail, wearing a white cropped tank top and blue jeans, stands in an outdoor area. She holds two large, orange-brown dried mullet roe pieces up to her face, smiling broadly. (2) The camera pans across a wide outdoor field where hundreds of mullet roe pieces are laid out on wooden racks to dry under a blue mesh shade. (3) A young man in a pink t-shirt and a bright neon green cross-body bag holds two pieces of roe, showing them to the camera with an excited expression. (4) A close-up shot shows a person's hands wearing grey gloves using a knife to gut a fish and carefully remove the orange roe inside a workshop. (5) The man in the pink shirt stands inside a shop area, negotiating with an older woman wearing a red vest and a blue face mask. (6) Two vacuum-sealed packages of mullet roe are held up, displaying the final product. (7) A group of people, including the main woman and man, stand near the drying racks talking and laughing. The woman now wears a blue bucket hat. (8) The man holds a plastic bag containing purchases above his head while walking outside in the sunny weather.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Exploration -> Interaction -> Transaction -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides an engaging look at a local mullet roe drying facility in Yunlin, Taiwan. It serves as both a food review and a lifestyle vlog, showcasing the scale of the production, the texture of the product, and the humorous interactions involved in bargaining with local vendors.
